verdict.rationale: AMD's own Instinct tooling supports headless, automated operation: a user-space CLI-style tool (AMD SMI), container runtime integration, a Kubernetes GPU Operator, a Slurm-compatible job scheduler, and scripted cluster validation. Nothing documents CI-pipeline usage specifically, and the depth of these tools is shown only by one-line descriptions. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration documentation or recipes, detailed docs on non-interactive and scripted operation, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: AMD SMI Unified user-space tool to manage and monitor GPUs and drivers.
GPU Operator Deploy and manage Instinct GPUs in Kubernetes clusters.
Spur AI-native job scheduler, drop-in compatible with Slurm, with GPU-first scheduling and Raft-based state.
Cluster Validation Suite Test scripts that validate AMD AI clusters end to end.
AMD Container Toolkit Integrate Instinct GPUs with Docker and container runtimes.
